messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **federal holidays that create “long weekends”** in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the *observed* day is the following Monday.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if applicable) | Long‑weekend span |
|---------|-------------|---------------------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | Jan 2–4 |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB, ON) | Monday Feb 20 | – | Feb 18–20 |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | – | Apr 7–9 |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | – | May 20–22 |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | Jul 3–5 |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | – | Sep 2–4 |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | – | Oct 7–9 |
| Remembrance Day (observed) | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | Nov 11–13 |
| Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | – | Dec 23–25 |

> **Note:**  
> • The table lists only **federal holidays** that generate a long weekend.  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) that may also create long weekends.  
> • If you need province‑specific data, let me know which provinces you’re interested in.

**Quick reference links**  
- [Government of Canada – Federal Holidays](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/holiday.html)  
- [Canada Day – Official Observance](https://www.canada.ca/en/canadian-heritage/services/canada-day.html)

Feel free to copy/paste the table into your holiday‑planning app, or let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (JSON, CSV, etc.).
